rationale.generate_tests: Use qwen-local for non-user-facing test generation to avoid cloud cost; test generation is advisory and can tolerate lower model capability while still catching simple issues.
rationale.review_solution: Use gpt-4.1-mini-cloud for branch-control review/routing to maintain reliable decisions at lower cost than gpt-5.5-cloud; endpoint supports required capabilities.

proposals.description: Explore whether keeping the strongest model on implementation and branch-control review while moving the initial planning step to the free local model improves cost/latency trade-offs without weakening the core solution/revision loop. Tests remain on gpt-4.1-mini-cloud for reliable test generation at modest cloud cost.

rationale.understand_and_plan: Use qwen-local for the non-user-facing planning stage to reduce cloud cost; this placement has not been evaluated in combination with gpt-5.5 review and mini test generation.
rationale.implement_solution: Keep gpt-5.5-cloud on the final scored solution implementation, the highest-impact user-facing code generation role.
rationale.generate_tests: Use gpt-4.1-mini-cloud for test generation because it is inexpensive but likely more dependable than the 2B local model for constructing relevant Python tests.
rationale.review_solution: Use gpt-5.5-cloud for solution review/routing, a branch-control role where stronger reasoning may improve decisions about revising versus finishing.

proposals.description: Cost-focused hybrid placement that keeps implementation, testing, and branch-control review on gpt-4.1-mini while moving only the non-branching planning step to the zero-cost local model. This map is not among the previously rejected unprofiled assignments.

rationale.understand_and_plan: Planning is non-user-facing, does not require tool use or structured output, and can often tolerate a smaller local model; using qwen-local reduces cloud cost and likely latency/cost for this initial step while respecting its 32k context window.
rationale.implement_solution: The final user-facing code generation step benefits from gpt-4.1-mini's stronger coding ability than the 2B local model at much lower cost than gpt-5.5.
rationale.generate_tests: Test generation benefits from gpt-4.1-mini for reasonable coverage and reliability, while avoiding the high cost of gpt-5.5.
rationale.review_solution: Review_solution controls branching, so keeping it on gpt-4.1-mini provides reliable routing decisions with tool/structured capabilities available if needed, without paying gpt-5.5 rates.
